name: Crear Fabrica
on: [workflow_dispatch]
jobs:
  crear:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Crear archivos
        run: |
          rm -f *.zip *.html *.zip.html
          rm -rf app gradle build.gradle settings.gradle gradlew gradlew.bat || true
          echo aW5jbHVkZSAnOmFwcCc= | base64 -d > "settings.gradle"
          echo YnVpbGRzY3JpcHQgeyByZXBvc2l0b3JpZXMgeyBnb29nbGUoKTsgbWF2ZW5DZW50cmFsKCkgfSBkZXBlbmRlbmNpZXMgeyBjbGFzc3BhdGggJ2NvbS5hbmRyb2lkLnRvb2xzLmJ1aWxkOmdyYWRsZTo4LjIuMicgfSB9IGFsbHByb2plY3RzIHsgcmVwb3NpdG9yaWVzIHsgZ29vZ2xlKCk7IG1hdmVuQ2VudHJhbCgpIH0gfQ== | base64 -d > "build.gradle"
          echo IyEvYmluL3NoCmV4ZWMgZ3JhZGxlICIkQCIK | base64 -d > "gradlew"
          echo QGVjaG8gb2ZmCmdyYWRsZSAlKgo= | base64 -d > "gradlew.bat"
          mkdir -p app
          echo  | base64 -d > "app/build.gradle"
          mkdir -p app/src/main
          echo  | base64 -d > "app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
          mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/fabrica/maestra
          echo  | base64 -d > "app/src/main/java/com/fabrica/maestra/MainActivity.java"
          mkdir -p gradle/wrapper
          echo ZGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVXJsPWh0dHBzXDovL3NlcnZpY2VzLmdyYWRsZS5vcmcvZGlzdHJpYnV0aW9ucy9ncmFkbGUtOC41LWJpbi56aXAK | base64 -d > "gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties"
          chmod +x gradlew
          ls -la
      - name: Subir
        run: |
          git config user.name "fabrica"
          git config user.email "fabrica@bot.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Fabrica creada" || true
          git push
